integrity: The theorem uses the source general inequality and an independent asymptotic calculation. Finite verification checks arithmetic and hook products but is not used as a proof of the infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: This is an explicit lower bound from one parameter family; it does not determine the exact limsup or prove global optimality. The motivating preprint is recent, so equivalent unindexed work remains a residual originality risk.
title: A stronger quadratic lower bound for brick-chain filtration growth from a seven-arrow rectangle
